case_number: 2025 INSC 55; Criminal Appeal No. ………….. of 2025 (@ Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No. 5896 of 2024)

parties.respondent: Dinesh Kumar Mahto @ Dinesh Kumar Mahato and another

summary: Maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C. vs decree for restitution of conjugal rights; Section 125(4) Cr.P.C. exception examined; wife's refusal to comply with restitution decree not automatic bar to maintenance; statutory purpose of social justice, women's dignity, prevention of destitution; duty of spouse to maintain irrespective of restitution; High Court erred in denying maintenance solely based on non-compliance; restitution decree does not negate husband's obligation to maintain; conjugal rights and maintenance are distinct remedies; appeal allowed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; maintenance award reinstated.
